title: Salsa Dancing Beginner Basics Tutorial Video

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains the steps clearly and demonstrates them from multiple angles. He emphasizes the importance of weight transfer and encourages students to focus on the basics.

lesson_structure.note: The teachers introduce themselves and the topic of the video.
The teacher breaks down the basic step in place.
The teacher explains the counting scheme for the basic step.
The teacher breaks down the forward and back basic step.
The teacher breaks down the side-to-side basic step.
The teacher breaks down the open break step (back and forward).

steps_taught.name: Basic in place
steps_taught.description: A basic step performed in place with weight shifts.

steps_taught.name: Forward and back basic
steps_taught.description: A basic step moving forward and backward.

steps_taught.name: Side to side basic
steps_taught.description: A basic step moving side to side.

steps_taught.name: Open break
steps_taught.description: A basic step with an open break, performed both back and forward.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the steps into small, manageable parts.
The teacher provides clear verbal cues and demonstrates the steps from multiple angles.
what_hinders: The teacher does not provide any visual aids or diagrams to help with the explanation.

quotes.text: Make sure you're actually shifting your weight each time.
Why is he not saying four and eight?
Do not worry about the details that a lot of people teach in different ways.
Don't worry about so much about body movement or flavor.
If you have to rewind or pause it, do anything to practice before you move on.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher demonstrates the basic step in place, shifting weight from left to right.
The teacher counts out loud while demonstrating the basic step.
The teacher demonstrates the forward and back basic step.
The teacher demonstrates the side-to-side basic step.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a 'recap' method where he repeats the steps multiple times to ensure the students have mastered them.
